identity_before_symbols: Compare live $C000-$FDFF to the integrated candidate resident artifact.

delivery_mechanics.monitor_constraint: Never use -gdb and -monitor simultaneously on the same XRoar process; do not extend the monitor protocol.

phases.name: delivery identity
phases.success_marker: Current ROM identity plus resident/staged/live byte equality; current maps resolve the watched routines and destinations.
phases.timeout_meaning: Identity/control boundary absent; not evidence that game code is slow.

phases.name: natural life chain
phases.success_marker: Natural credited start, watches armed before state-2 cue admission, one initial entry, and two genuine enemy-contact replacements through marker columns x=33/35/37; one life decrement and cue-6 admission per entry.
phases.timeout_meaning: Named lifecycle marker absent; no missing path counts as pass.
phases.risk: Life accounting, marker-column padding, visible route, and replacement onset.

phases.name: cue-first and automatic-control gates
phases.success_marker: Cue-6-owned first actual SND_DATA output, attributed to the same service's mixed stream, precedes entrant FRONT publication; held input causes no accepted player-control change or input-caused automatic-route/facing deviation; no contact/death or new cue-13 enqueue.
phases.timeout_meaning: Cue-owned output or expected entry marker absent; slot ID/enqueue/busy state is insufficient evidence.
phases.risk: Audio onset order, accidental control, or death-event reentry.

phases.name: prior-music and completion orders
phases.success_marker: Qualified prior music drains before cue-6 entry; both music-first and final-pose-commit-first orders release only after post-PSG idle publication and actual final FRONT pose.
phases.timeout_meaning: Required active prior music or a gate order was not reached; scenario is absent and fails.

phases.name: HUD and row rendering
phases.success_marker: Fit/static contract already proves all 24 row identities; runtime top/bottom destinations and pixels match through each isolated owner; natural alternating FRONT sequence; part/vegetable HUD output at stages 1/10/100/255 matches pinned pre-BUG-117 baseline.
phases.timeout_meaning: Expected destination or output evidence absent; no owner or stage case may be inferred from another.
phases.risk: Shared row arithmetic, adjacent coordinate stores, register clobber, and persistent owner rendering.

phases.name: independent worklist timing
phases.success_marker: Current integrated required worklists meet 27000 cycles.
phases.timeout_meaning: Measurement did not return in the bounded phase; record the probe boundary and last proven marker, not an inference that target code is slow.
phases.risk: Existing independent performance acceptance. Historical 42541/54539 maxima remain failed, not waived.

remaining_execution_gates: Approved all-profile fit passes measured capacity targets.
Parent integrates the exact fit patch and builds the combined current source.
Parent pins the combined build maps, baseline identity, and byte manifest.
The guarded observer receives the narrow fields/scenario above; no legacy observer is imported.
Parent assigns Ready execution and an evidence destination.
Specify valid concrete scheduling/queue mechanics to force both completion orders; no clock/framebuffer-owner/terminal-status writes may manufacture a pass.
evidence_retention: Concise hashes, phase markers, actual PSG/FRONT observations, event order, and failing boundary only. No probes were run for this planning step.
